title: cajanus helvolus
intro: Cajanus helvolus, commonly known as hairy neelam or hairy adansonia, is a plant species in the Fabaceae family. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include various health benefits such as antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antidiabetic activities, making it a potential treatment for various conditions. The therapeutic actions of Cajanus helvolus include its ability to act as an anti-arthritic agent, an anti-hypertensive, and a hepatoprotective agent, showcasing its potential in treating various diseases. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
